free_text.inst.v2.D8: I would rather be let alone. What is on the record is enough: a poor childhood in Sodermalm, my father gone when I was fourteen, the store and the barbershop, the Dramatic Theatre school, Stiller, and then America. I worked for a studio for sixteen years, I was never married, I had no children, and after 1941 I did not make another picture. I kept my money, my pictures on the wall, and my privacy. Anything beyond that is other people's invention.

notes: Answered strictly from documented public biography of Greta Lovisa Gustafsson (b. 18 Sept 1905, Stockholm; d. 15 April 1990, New York). No chart, horoscope, verdict or reading file was opened or reasoned about; no code was run. Key anchors: father Karl Alfred Gustafsson died June 1920 (she was 14); sister Alva died 1926; brother Sven; she was the youngest of three; left school early and worked as a lather-girl and then at PUB; scholarship to the Royal Dramatic Theatre training school 1922; breakthrough in The Saga of Gosta Berling (1924); sailed to the US July 1925 for MGM; Anna Christie (1930) and Ninotchka (1939) each drew acclaim and Oscar nominations; renegotiated contract in the early 1930s made her one of the highest-paid people in Hollywood; Two-Faced Woman (1941) closed her career at 35/36 and she never returned; honorary Academy Award 1954; US citizen 1951; settled at 450 East 52nd Street, New York, from the early 1950s; never married, no children; long relationships (Gilbert, de Acosta, Schlee) all ended; large fortune from shrewd investment in shares, real estate and art; lifelong reputation for solitude, reticence, insomnia and melancholy; kidney failure and pneumonia at the end of her life. Deliberate uncertainties: A1/A2 give the commonly cited 19:30 Stockholm time as a half-hour figure rather than claim clock precision; A3, A8 and A9 answered 'unknown' because nothing reliable is published; A12 'distant' is the careful reading (she supported her mother but was closer to her father); A4/A5 are conservative counts from the few documented late-life hospitalisations. A25 omitted (never married). A36 is unanswerable for a woman who died in 1990 - 'same' is a placeholder, not a claim. D1-D4 omitted deliberately: they ask which chapters of a reading were wrong or right, and per the task rules no reading or verdict file was consulted, so any answer would be fabricated.
